summary: Client-only request of the 'mon' debug monitor (EocServerMonitor) for wall debugging. Registered by bg3.exe+0x11EEE60 (size 0x18, align 0x18 in the packed size word 0x180018, no destructor). The default constructor writes a null EntityHandle first - the usual shape of a request that names the entity it concerns - then zeroes two quadwords. No system of the shipped binaries fills or reads it. Never seen alive.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: default constructor bg3.exe+0x11F0D30 (slot 3 of ops table bg3.exe+0x5567238 registered by bg3.exe+0x11EEE60) stores 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +0; macOS default constructor stores the same constant at +0.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x11F0D30 stores 0 as a quadword at +8.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x11F0D30 stores 0 as a quadword at +0x10 (macOS: 32-bit zero at +0x10 plus the stp at +8).

open_questions: Meaning of +8 and +0x10 (real widths may be smaller); whether +0 is really an entity (only the null default says so). No reader exists in the shipped binaries.
status_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
second_pass: Cannot be settled from code: the second pass found no producer or consumer anywhere - bg3.exe has only the type registration (App::CreateECS -> bg3.exe+0x11EExxx), the static type-name initialiser and the component ops; the macOS build has only ComponentOps/ComponentSignals/destructor instantiations (macos_index.py names '<mon::' lists just the eight mon types) and the Toolkit DLLs mention them only in App::AddGlobalSwitchesToOptionDialog. The shapes from the creator/destructor stand; the members stay unknown.
